nodes.title: fix(label): show the real total in the list header
nodes.description:
## Description

`glab label list` passed `len(labels)` as both the count and the total in its
header, so the total was always the size of the current page. A project with 33
labels showed `Showing label 30 of 30` with the default page size, and
`3 of 3` on page 2.

This keeps the `*gitlab.Response` returned by `ListLabels` and
`ListGroupLabels`, and builds the header with `utils.NewListTitle`, as other
list commands do (modelled on `container_registry/repository/list`):

- The total comes from `resp.TotalItems`.
- When the response carries no total (GitLab omits `X-Total` for very large
  result sets), the header omits "of N" instead of repeating the page count.
- An empty list prints `No labels available on ...`.
- The group case sets `RepoName` to the group, like `mr list`.

The header format changes accordingly, for example
`Showing label 30 of 30 on OWNER/REPO.` becomes
`Showing 30 of 33 labels on OWNER/REPO. (Page 1)`, and the group header reads
`on GROUP` instead of `for group GROUP`.

The table body and the JSON output are unchanged.

## Related Issues

Resolves #8573

Related to #1165, which covers list commands that print no total at all.
`glab iteration list` has the same header bug and will get its own merge
request.

## How has this been tested?

- `internal/commands/label/list/label_list_test.go`:
  - Updated the expected headers of the existing cases.
  - Project and group cases that mock `TotalItems: 33` and expect `of 33`.
    Both fail on `main` with `2 of 2` / `1 of 1`.
  - A response without a total, which prints `Showing 2 labels ...` with no
    "of N".
  - An empty list, which prints `No labels available on OWNER/REPO.`
- `go test ./internal/commands/label/...` and
  `go vet ./internal/commands/label/list/` pass.
- `golangci-lint run ./internal/commands/label/...` (v2.14.0, as pinned in
  `.tool-versions`) reports 0 issues, and `golangci-lint fmt --diff` reports no
  changes.
- `go run ./scripts/comment-overlap` reports 0 findings on the changed files.
- Ran a build of this branch against a self-managed GitLab 19.3.3-ee project
  with 33 labels:

  | Command | `main` | This branch |
  |---|---|---|
  | `glab label list` | `Showing label 30 of 30 on OWNER/REPO.` | `Showing 30 of 33 labels on OWNER/REPO. (Page 1)` |
  | `glab label list -p 2` | `Showing label 3 of 3 on OWNER/REPO.` | `Showing 3 of 33 labels on OWNER/REPO. (Page 2)` |
  | `glab label list -P 10` | `Showing label 10 of 10 on OWNER/REPO.` | `Showing 10 of 33 labels on OWNER/REPO. (Page 1)` |
  | `glab label list -g GROUP` | `Showing label 30 of 30 for group GROUP.` | `Showing 30 of 33 labels on GROUP. (Page 1)` |

  The table body and `-F json` output are byte-identical to `main`.
